title: The Unquiet: First Rites

texts.details:
Ya can close a wound, mon. So can a needle. Dat not what makes a priest of de Darkspear.

Dere be a spirit in de hills south-west of here. It was a person once, an' it don't know it be dead. It walks where it used ta walk, an' gets angry dat nobody answers. De grunts be scared of it. Dey should be ashamed, leavin' it so.

We speak wit' de spirits, $N. We bargain wit' dem. Dat be our way. But a spirit like dis one got nothin' left ta bargain with. So we give, an' ask nothin'. Go an' give it rest. It gonna fight ya. Dey always tink ya came ta take de last ting dey got.
texts.objectives: Lay the Restless Shade to rest, in the dry hills south-west of Razor Hill, then return to your teacher.
texts.progress: Go easy, as far as it lets ya.
texts.completion:
At rest? Good. Dat be de oldest ting a priest does, mon. Older dan any temple.

De loa be great an' dey want great tings: offerings, idols, worship. But de small dead, de ones nobody remembers, dey got no loa lookin' out for dem. Dey be ours.

Dis world had tree wars an' a plague since my father was young. It be full of de unquiet, an' every one be a piece of what happened dat nobody stayed ta bury. I want ya ta go to dem, $N. Take one of dese. When ya got twenty seasons, cross de sea to de Undercity an' find de banshee Aelthalyste. She knows about not bein' able ta leave.

idea: The Unquiet, level 10 (Horde): lay one restless shade near home, in the voice of the priest's own faith. Invented: the shade.
